news.title: Merlin Group plans ₹10,000 crore investment over five years; targets ₹700 crore sales in FY27
news.para: Merlin Group plans to deploy about ₹10,000 crore over the next five years across residential, commercial, retail and mixed-use projects, said Sushil Mohta, chairman, Merlin Group and president, CREDAI West Bengal. The developer, which recorded sales of around ₹500 crore in FY26, is targeting about ₹700 crore in FY27 and has nearly 20 million sq ft of development potential lined up for launch over the next two-three years.

news.title: Old legislations impeding development must go: West Bengal finance minister
news.para: West Bengal finance minister Swapan Dasgupta said legacy land laws, including the Urban Land (Ceiling and Regulation) Act, need to be reviewed or removed where they restrict development, as the state seeks to attract organised developers and industrial investment. He also called for greater regulation, accountability and transparency in the real estate sector.

news.title: Ajmera Realty looks to create two million sq ft of rental portfolio  in Mumbai over next 5-8 years
news.para: Ajmera Realty & Infra (India) is targeting ₹2,200 crore of pre-sales in FY27 and expects to invest over ₹1,000 crore across its existing and upcoming projects over the next three-four years, said Dhaval Ajmera, director-corporate affairs. The company is also looking to build around two million sq ft of rental assets in Mumbai over the next five-eight years.

news.title: Naiknavare Developers targets 20% revenue growth in FY27; plans ₹125 crore-plus co-living investment
news.para: Naiknavare Developers is targeting about 20% revenue growth in FY27 and plans to invest over ₹125 crore in the next two years to build its co-living business. The Pune-based developer is targeting around 5,000 co-living beds over seven years while expanding across redevelopment, senior living and select Mumbai projects.

news.title: Infrastructure must precede real estate development in Indian cities: CREDAI
news.para: CREDAI has called for an infrastructure-first approach to urban development, arguing that roads, drainage, transport and civic services should be planned ahead of large-scale real estate expansion. Industry leaders at NATCON 2026 also highlighted the need for redevelopment frameworks as Indian cities absorb a larger urban population.

news.title: Kochi metro phase-II construction to be completed in August 2027
news.para: Kochi Metro Rail Ltd is determined to complete its Phase II expansion by August 2027. Managing director G Priyanka stressed the critical need for swift progress on construction. The review covered vital components like track laying, station development, and electrical installations. KMRL aims to boost its finances by introducing new commercial strategies and filling essential positions.

news.title: Goa government clears land for first affordable housing project in Parcem
news.para: In a significant move, the Goa government has sanctioned the land transfer at Parcem to the Goa Housing Board. This site is set to host the state's inaugural affordable housing complex as part of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana initiative. To ensure the effective rollout of this affordable housing strategy across Goa, a consultant has been appointed.

news.title: Trichy civic body warns builders over illegal construction & demolition waste dumping
news.para: Trichy corporation commissioner N Ponmalai has issued a stern warning to builders concerning the illegal dumping of construction materials, responding to rising public grievances. He emphasized that penalties will be enforced on offenders disrupting traffic, particularly in areas like Thennur and Vayalur Road. The commissioner reminded all sites to comply with guidelines and exhibit necessary approvals. As a proactive measure, a C&D waste recycling unit is planned for Panjapur.

news.title: High court sets aside Kolkata civic bodu's closure order against hotel
news.para: The Calcutta High Court has ruled against the Kolkata Municipal Corporation, stating they wrongfully suspended Hotel Emirates’ trade licence without providing a proper hearing. The court emphasized that the hotel had a valid enlistment certificate until March 2027, and the KMC's suspension order lacked evidence of any police licence violations, underscoring the need for fairness in business regulations.

news.title: CenturyPly plans ₹200 crore capital expenditure in FY27; ₹250-350 crore in FY28
news.para: CenturyPly is targeting revenue of ₹10,000-12,000 crore by 2031 and plans to invest about ₹2,500 crore over five years to expand capacity, said Nikita Agarwal Bansal, executive director, CenturyPly. The company plans about ₹200 crore capex in FY27 and ₹250-350 crore subsequently for plywood expansion, while aiming to raise its share of the overall plywood market to 15% over the next four years.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh: UPPCB puts up 90 cameras to check dust-control measures at construction sites
news.para: To tackle the escalating pollution levels at construction sites in Noida, the Uttar Pradesh Pollution Control Board has initiated a surveillance program featuring camera installations at 90 construction locations. This step not only aligns with the National Green Tribunal’s dust-control mandates but also urges developers to comply with environmental standards. A dedicated control room will soon monitor the success and application of these dust management measures.

news.title: Garib Nagar rehabilitation: All 100 Bandra families allotted Kurla flats, possession process begins
news.para: After months of uncertainty, 100 residents from Garib Nagar received keys to their new rehabilitation flats in Kurla. The MMRDA utilized a newly developed computerized system to ensure transparency in the allotment process. Delays in the rehabilitation were primarily due to the lack of required occupation certificates for the buildings. This move follows the demolition of nearly 500 structures in Garib Nagar for railway infrastructure expansion.

news.title: Over 24,000 Vijayawada families get ownership rights to decades-old house sites
news.para: Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu has made a considerable impact by distributing regularisation pattas to over 24,000 families for their house sites in Vijayawada. With a projected value of Rs 9,800 crore, this initiative aims to eliminate long-standing ownership conflicts. By supporting various social categories, the government ensures that families gain legal security over their properties, contributing to a more stable community and addressing ongoing land disputes across the state.

news.title: Kalyan MHADA project: Homebuyers allege ₹176 crore collected, construction stalled since 2022
news.para: Frustrated homebuyers have lodged complaints against Tycoon Avanti Projects LLP, alleging serious delays in a redevelopment project that has left them without their promised flats after substantial payments. The Shantidoot Cooperative Housing Society reports ongoing financial and construction problems dating back to 2022. Although the developer denies involvement in any financial misconduct, they attribute the issues to regulatory hold-ups.

news.title: RBI imposes ₹4.8 crore fine on BPTP over FDI diversion
news.para: The Reserve Bank of India has announced a hefty fine of ₹4.8 crore against BPTP Ltd due to breaches of FEMA regulations concerning foreign direct investment from the years 2007 and 2008. The company will pay ₹4 crore, and its two directors will each incur a penalty of ₹40.36 lakh.

news.title: India office absorption rises 8% to 66.4 million sq ft in Jan-Sep 2026: Report
news.para: Office absorption across India reached a record 66.4 million sq ft during January-September 2026, up 8% year-on-year, while new supply rose 18% to 51 million sq ft, according to CBRE. GCC leasing touched an all-time nine-month high of 28 million sq ft.

news.title: WeWork India receives ₹11 crore GST demand notice over alleged excess input tax credit
news.para: WeWork India Management has received a show cause-cum-demand notice from the CGST authorities alleging excess availment and utilisation of input tax credit of ₹11.01 crore for the period April 2021 to March 2023. The company said it does not expect any material impact on its financials or operations at this stage.

news.title: Anarock files draft papers for ₹1,000 crore IPO; plans ₹148 crore for DSP stake acquisition
news.para: Anarock Property Consultants’ proposed IPO comprises a ₹550 crore fresh issue and a ₹450 crore offer for sale. The company plans to deploy ₹148 crore towards acquiring further shares in DSP Design Associates, ₹120 crore on AI and technology, and ₹89.50 crore on strengthening its teams.

news.title: Former director of Raheja Developers moves Delhi HC for anticipatory bail, ED opposes plea
news.para: The Delhi High Court on Thursday heard the arguements of the Enforcement Directorate (ED) on the anticipatory bail plea of former Director of Raheja Developer Ltd. (RDL), Nayan N Raheja, in a money laundering case.

news.title: Dosti Realty, Moneytree Realty file IPO papers with Sebi through confidential route
news.para: Dosti Realty Ltd and Moneytree Realty Services Ltd have both opted for a confidential approach in filing their IPOs with Sebi, enabling them to keep their offering specifics under wraps until further regulatory assessments take place. Dosti Realty, located in Mumbai, boasts a track record of over 143 completed properties across diverse segments, while Moneytree Realty specializes in advisory services nationwide.
